content.title: Gothic Portrait Carousel | Face Anchor, Background Chapters and Surface Finish
content.summary: An adult curator remains fixed while icon, graffiti and paper-wall systems rotate. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult identity anchors every visual chapter. + Face, hair and body proportions do not change. + Background systems switch as bounded groups. + Effects may cross the edge but not hide identity anchors. + No source makeup design, slogans or exact graphic marks are copied.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one original adult night-club curator with a black bob, silver eye line and a fitted graphite coat. Switch the background to cyan graffiti and one restrained magenta channel offset without changing the model. Return to a centered portrait against the peeled wall with no inherited words or symbols.
required_anchors: One clearly adult identity anchors every visual chapter.
Face, hair and body proportions do not change.
Effects may cross the edge but not hide identity anchors.
No source makeup design, slogans or exact graphic marks are copied.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult curator remains fixed while icon, graffiti and paper-wall systems rotate. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 固定同一成年哥特模特的脸、发型、妆面和服装轮廓，背景在图标、涂鸦、色差和剥落墙面间成组切换；人物只做小幅姿态变化，终局回到稳定肖像。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult identity anchors every visual chapter.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult identity anchors every visual chapter."

invariants.rule: Face, hair and body proportions do not change.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Face, hair and body proportions do not change."

invariants.rule: Background systems switch as bounded groups.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Background systems switch as bounded groups."

invariants.rule: Effects may cross the edge but not hide identity anchors.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Effects may cross the edge but not hide identity anchors."

invariants.rule: No source makeup design, slogans or exact graphic marks are copied.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "No source makeup design, slogans or exact graphic marks are copied."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
